gen_nurbs_interp — MV curve op

• Data kinds: keypoints → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.gen_nurbs_interp(points, degree=3) (to call the implementation directly, import mvtext; mvtext.gen_nurbs_interp(points, degree=3); from the registry, opsmv.get("gen_nurbs_interp"))

• HALCON equivalent: gen_nurbs_interp (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Find the control points of a non-rational B-spline through every point (global interpolation).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

媒介変数は弦長、節点は媒介変数の平均(The NURBS Book の 9.2.1)で決め、基底の線形方程式を解く。重みは全部 1 なので、返りをそのまま nurbs_curve に渡せる(knots と degree も一緒に渡す)。連続する同じ点は ValueError(弦長が 0 になり媒介変数が決まらない)。空の入力(points が 0 要素)は ValueError。

Args:

points: (N, d) の点列(N > degree)。

degree: 次数(>= 1)。

Returns:

control_points (N, d)、knots (N+degree+1,)、weights、degree、u を持つ dict。
